cds.text: Identify how curriculum texts are organised differently and use language features depending on purpose
Describe how curriculum texts use different language features and structures relevant to their purpose
Identify how texts have different language features and are typically organised into characteristic stages by purpose
Understand how texts are made cohesive through personal and possessive pronouns and omitting inferable words
Understand that paragraphs organise written texts by grouping related information together
Identify how connectives (temporal and conditional words) and topic word associations sequence and connect ideas
Navigate print and screen texts using chapters, contents, indexes, side-bar or drop-down menus, and links
Identify the purpose of layout features in print and digital texts, and the words used for navigation
Identify online text navigation features that enhance readability, such as headlines, drop-down menus, links, graphics and layout

Create and edit short imaginative, informative and persuasive texts for familiar audiences, using purpose-appropriate structure, simple and compound sentences, noun and verb groups, and common two-syllable words
Plan, create, edit and publish imaginative, informative and persuasive texts with visual features, layout, simple paragraphs, mostly correct tense and most high-frequency words spelled correctly
Plan, create, edit and publish texts with visual features, linked ideas, complex sentences, appropriate tense, synonyms, antonyms, correctly spelled multisyllabic words and simple punctuation
Create, rehearse and deliver short presentations for familiar audiences, using purpose-appropriate structure, topic vocabulary, and varied tone, volume and pace
Plan, rehearse and deliver short presentations to inform, express opinions or tell stories, with clear structure, elaborated details, precise vocabulary, visual features and suitable delivery
Plan, rehearse and deliver structured presentations to report, tell stories, recount events or argue, using subjective and objective language, complex sentences and visual features
Write words legibly, with growing fluency, using unjoined upper-case and lower-case letters
Write words using joined letters that are clearly formed and consistent in size
Write words using clearly formed joined letters, with developing fluency and automaticity
